name: OpenHands Cloud
desc: Hosted OpenHands you run in the browser instead of installing.
desc_zh: 在浏览器里直接使用、无需安装的托管版 OpenHands。
solves: The self-hosted agent needs Docker and a machine you maintain; the hosted version starts a session from a link.
solves_zh: 自建智能体要 Docker 和一台自己维护的机器；托管版点开链接就能开会话。
best_for: You want to try the agent on a repository without setting anything up locally.
best_for_zh: 想先在某个仓库上试试这个智能体，又不想在本地装任何东西。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — openhands.dev/blog directory）。 Full release of the hosted platform. Predates the window but is absent from the ledger, so it is recorded under rule (b). A self-hosted Cloud option followed on 2025-06-18. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.openhands.dev/blog/introducing-the-openhands-cloud
